fusions.name: Cropping Bite
fusions.desc: Your next weapon strike deals 8 piercing damage, heals you for 30% of the damage dealt and leaves the target [Bleeding] for 1 damage a second for 3 seconds. It needs one of your afflictions on the target and uses it up.

fusions.name: Gorging Trample
fusions.desc: Tramples the ground and deals 28 blunt damage to every enemy within 3 tiles, plus 4% of a boss or elite's maximum health, and heals you for 20% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Shared Meadow
fusions.desc: Restores 15 health to you and every ally within 3.5 tiles, and more the faster you cast. Your movement speed rises by 15% for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Eat and Run
fusions.desc: Each time you are healed, you regain 10 stamina. Once every 8 seconds.
